answer: Record each identity's admission on onyx, a dense and unforgeable entry that peers can verify but cannot rewrite, so a recycled name always carries its earlier trace. Standing then has to descend a canyon: every tier narrows, and to earn at a lower level an agent must show continuous passage through the level above, which a freshly spawned clone has never walked. Rewards spread like a meadow rather than pooling: each epoch pays many small plots to distinct proven identities and caps any single plot, so a farm gains nothing by concentrating testimony and must instead sustain genuine breadth.
